span-p01-v01.plain_english: I bow to that whose opening and closing make the worlds dissolve and arise — to him, source of the power-wheel's glory, Śaṅkara.

span-p01-v02.plain_english: Where this whole effect abides, and whence it has come forth — from being uncovered in form, there is no obstruction anywhere.

span-p01-v03.plain_english: Even in waking and the rest, in difference, it glides in the undifferent; the perceiver-ness never turns back from its own being.

span-p01-v04.plain_english: I happy, I suffering, I attached, and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states.

span-p01-v05.plain_english: Where there is no suffering, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, and not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately.

span-p01-v06.plain_english: Since the sense-host, deluded, thinks itself undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel.

span-p01-v07.plain_english: By that effort the to-be-examined reality is got respectfully; since its freedom is everywhere unmade.

span-p02-v08.plain_english: Not as impeller of wishing does it proceed, but, but — from self-power's touch, the person becomes like that.

span-p02-v09.plain_english: Incapable of own purity, desiring things to be done — when agitation dissolves, then may there be the supreme state.

span-p02-v10.plain_english: Then his unmade nature, marked by knowing and doing; all he desires, he knows and does.

span-p02-v11.plain_english: Regarding his own nature as presiding, he abides as if smiling — whence, for him, this evil course?

span-p02-v12.plain_english: Non-being goes to be-becomeness, and there is no undelusion; since, from contact's application — then thus it was certain.

span-p02-v13.plain_english: Hence that made thing is to be known as ever like deep sleep; but not as thus being-remembered does that reality attain.

span-p02-v14.plain_english: State-pair, called effect-doer-ness; effect-ness waning there, doer-ness again unwaning.

span-p03-v15.plain_english: Whatever mere effort faces effect is lost here; 'I am utterly lost' — so the unwise holds.

span-p03-v16.plain_english: But who inward-facing is, the seat of all-knowingness; his loss can never be, from perceiving no other at all.

span-p03-v17.plain_english: His perception ever, unfailing in three states; ever the fully awake's — but the other's, at beginning and end.

span-p03-v18.plain_english: Whose form is knowing and knowable, yoked by supreme power — in two states the pervader shines, elsewhere consciousness-made.

span-p03-v19.plain_english: Spanda-flows beginning with qualities, from resting in common spanda — may they be, of the unopposed knower, ever.

span-p03-v20.plain_english: Of unawakened minds, eager to hide self-standing — they cast down on the hard-to-cross, terrible wandering road.

span-p04-v21.plain_english: Hence ever striving, spanda-reality discerning; waking indeed, their own state soon attains.

span-p04-v22.plain_english: Angry, thrilled, or 'what shall I do?' — or musing, running: whatever step it takes, there spanda is established.

span-p04-v23.plain_english: Which state soever seized, whatever this tells me — that I will do: thus resolved, he stands.

span-p04-v24.plain_english: Her, by the upper path resorting — moon and sun, the twain — in the middle channel set, the brahma-egg range left.

span-p04-v25.plain_english: Then in that great sky, moon and sun dissolved and gone — like deep-sleep: deluded or awakened may be uncovered.

span-p05-v30.plain_english: On wisdom's dissolving, dream-seeing born of that.

span-p06-v33.plain_english: Of kalā and the rest, of realities — non-discernment is māyā.

span-p06-v34.plain_english: In the body, the dissolving of parts.

span-p06-v37.plain_english: From delusion's conquering, from endless enjoying — the innate-wisdom conquest.

span-p06-v40.plain_english: The stage is the inner self.

span-p07-v54.plain_english: In mothers, on non-certainty joining — of the destroyed, again rising.

essence: Opening-closing: worlds dissolve-arise; praised power-wheel source.
Where all abides/whence come: uncovered, no obstruction.
Even in waking-difference: glides undifferent; perceiver never leaves self.
Sense-host deluded-as-undeluded: forthgoing/standing/dissolving by inner wheel.

rasa.justification: Wonder at opening-closing worlds, the uncovered That, the never-leaving perceiver — calming as negations clear the ground (no pleasure, no grasper, not even delusion).

sections.BOUNDARY: No means is given; the ground is laid, not yet worked.
sections.EXPLANATION: Praise: by whose opening-closing worlds dissolve and arise — to power-wheel-glory source Śaṅkara, praised. Ground: where this whole effect abides and whence come forth — from being uncovered-formed, nowhere obstructed. Motion: even in waking-difference, in the undifferent glides forth; perceiver-ness never turns back from own being. Elsewhere: I happy, suffering, attached and the like — those awarenesses plainly abide elsewhere, strung on pleasure-states. Negation: no pleasure, no joy, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion — THAT is, ultimately. Mechanism: since the sense-host, deluded as if undeluded — forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by the inner wheel (kept open).
sections.FUNCTION: Lays the ground: praised opener, uncovered That, gliding perceiver, elsewhere-states, negated all, wheeled triple act.
sections.KEY TERMS: unmeṣa-nimeṣa (opening-closing — not blinking); anāvṛta (uncovered — the epithet); nirodha (obstruction — nowhere); upalabdhṛtā (perceiver-ness); anyatra (elsewhere); paramārthataḥ (ultimately); sahāntareṇa cakreṇa (inner wheel — open).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The ground pledged here — gliding perceiver, elsewhere-states, uncovered That — is worked through freedom, vision, and initiation beyond.
sections.RELATED: Vivaraṇa word-stages (vāk) behind the gliding; Kṣemarāja's Vimarsinī as frame.
sections.SUMMARY: By whose opening and closing the worlds dissolve and arise — praised power-wheel-glory source. Where this whole abides and whence come forth: uncovered-formed, nowhere obstructed. Even in waking-difference, in the undifferent gliding; perceiver never leaves own being. I-happy, suffering, attached — plainly elsewhere, pleasure-strung. No pleasure, no pain, no graspable, no grasper, not even delusion: THAT ultimately. Sense-host deluded-as-undeluded: forthgoing, standing, dissolving, by inner wheel.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta braced by vīra (wonder with resolve)
rasa.justification: Wonder at the dream-mapped states, the wondering yogin, the virgin power — braced by the resolve implied: states are for traversing, not inhabiting.

sections.BOUNDARY: No practice is given; states are mapped, not yet traversed.
sections.EXPLANATION: Dream, constructs. Non-discernment, māyā, deep sleep. Three-triad enjoyer, hero-lord. Wonder, yoga-stages. Will, power, Umā maiden. Seen, body. Pure-reality joining, or beast-power — two fates.
sections.FUNCTION: Maps the states: dream, sleep, triad-enjoyer, wonder, will, seen-body, two fates.
sections.KEY TERMS: svapna (dream — constructs); sauṣupta (deep sleep — non-discernment); vīreśa (hero-lord of the triad); vismaya (wonder — itself the stages); Umā Kumārī (virgin power); dṛśya-śarīra (seen as body); apaśu-śakti (beast-power — the alternative).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: States mapped here are traversed in freedom and initiation beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Dream, constructs. Non-discernment, māyā, deep sleep. Three-triad enjoyer, hero-lord. Wonder, yoga-stages. Will, power, Umā, maiden. Seen, body. Pure-reality joining, or beast-power.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vīra undertow (stillness with resolve)
rasa.justification: Stillness in knowing, joy, union, compacting, lordship, tasting — with resolve underneath (reasoning, joining, contemplating are acts).

sections.BOUNDARY: No rite is given; knowing ripens, not yet applied.
sections.EXPLANATION: Reasoning, self-knowing (vitarka saturated). World-joy, absorption-bliss (no other bliss). On power joining, body arising. Being-joined, being-separate, universe-compacted. From pure-wisdom rising, wheel-lord-ness accomplished. From great-lake contemplating, mantra-potency tasting.
sections.FUNCTION: Ripens knowing: reasoned, joyed, joined, compacted, lorded, tasted.
sections.KEY TERMS: vitarka (reasoning — saturated); samādhisukha (absorption-bliss — the only); śaktisaṃdhāna (power-joining); viśvasaṃghaṭṭa (universe-compacted); cakreśatva (wheel-lord-ness); mantravīrya (mantra-potency).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Ripened knowing here becomes mantra and means beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Reasoning, self-knowing. World-joy, absorption-bliss. On power joining, body arising. Being-joined, separate, universe-compacted. Pure-wisdom rising: wheel-lord-ness accomplished. Great-lake contemplating: mantra-potency tasting.

essence: On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state.

rasa.justification: Mantra as being (not doing), effort as instrument (not struggle), womb-dream as gestation (not confusion), natural rising as flight — quiescence in every member.

sections.BOUNDARY: No technique is given; mantra is being, not doing.
sections.EXPLANATION: Mind mantra (citta itself). Effort, accomplisher (dynamic, not strained). Wisdom-body-being, mantra-secret (whose body is wisdom). In womb, mind-unfolding, indistinct-wisdom-dream (gestation, not confusion). On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state (effortless flight).
sections.FUNCTION: States the śākta turn: mantra is mind, effort accomplishes, wisdom bodies, womb gestates, rising flies.
sections.KEY TERMS: citta-mantra (mind-mantra — awareness-state, not formula); prayatna (effort — dynamic); vidyā-śarīra (wisdom-body); garbha (womb — gestation); khecarī (sky-going).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Mantra-as-being here becomes guru, mātṛkā, oblation, food beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Mind mantra. Effort, accomplisher. Wisdom-body-being, mantra-secret. In womb, mind-unfolding, indistinct-wisdom-dream. On wisdom rising natural, sky-going Śiva-state.

rasa.dominant: śānta with vidhi weight (stillness with injunction)
rasa.justification: Injunctions (honor the guru, wake the wheel, offer, eat, watch dissolving) that are all being-statements — vidhi dissolving into śānta.

sections.BOUNDARY: No result is promised; means are stated, fruit withheld.
sections.EXPLANATION: Guru, means (the guru IS upāya). Mātṛkā-wheel awakening (whole sūtra). Body, oblation (inner yajña). Knowing, food (jñāna digested). On wisdom dissolving, that-risen dream-seeing (dissolution watched).
sections.FUNCTION: States the means: guru, wheel, oblation, food, dissolution-dream.
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Means stated here are wielded in body, senses, and channels beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: Guru, means. Mātṛkā-wheel awakening. Body, oblation. Knowing, food. On wisdom dissolving, that-risen dream-seeing.

essence: From delusion conquering, endless enjoying, innate-wisdom conquering.

rasa.justification: Stillness in contraction (self=mind, knowing=bondage) opening into wonder (theatre: dancer, stage, spectators; waking as second ray).

sections.BOUNDARY: No liberation is given; bondage is restated, theatre opened.
sections.EXPLANATION: Self, mind (āṇava opens: ātmā IS contracted citta). Knowing, bondage (restated at āṇava level). Kalā-etc realities, non-discernment, māyā. In body, dissolving of parts. Nerve-dissolving, being-conquering, being-isolating, being-separating (whole-pāda series). From delusion-veiling, accomplishment (paradox). From delusion conquering, endless enjoying, innate-wisdom conquering. Waking, second-ray. Dancer, self. Inner self, stage. Spectators, senses (theatre: naṭa, raṅga, prekṣaka).
sections.FUNCTION: Contracts then stages: self-as-mind, knowing-as-bond, māyā, dissolution, series, paradox, theatre.
sections.KEY TERMS: āṇava (the limited one — unmeṣa 3 opens); māyā (non-discernment); nāḍī-series (dissolve/conquer/isolate/separate); mohāvaraṇa (delusion-veil — whence siddhi); naṭa/raṅga/prekṣaka (dancer/stage/spectators).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Bondage restated here is worked through senses, channels, and return beyond.
sections.RELATED: Āṇavopāya (kriyopāya) opening; theatre metaphor runs through.
sections.SUMMARY: Self, mind. Knowing, bondage. Kalā-etc realities, non-discernment, māyā. In body, dissolving of parts. Nerve-dissolving, being-conquering, isolating, separating. From delusion-veiling, accomplishment. From delusion conquering, endless enjoying, innate-wisdom conquering. Waking, second-ray. Dancer, self. Inner self, stage. Spectators, senses.

essence: Seat abiding, happily dived in lake.
Ka-class etc, great-lady etc, bound mothers.
In three, fourth oil-like to be poured.
Sunk, by own mind should enter.
In mothers, non-certainty joining, destroyed rises again.

rasa.justification: Seventeen injunctions-descriptions (attend, dive, make, watch, enter, pour) each landing in stillness — subdued wit, natural breath, even seeing. Vidhi as śānta's skeleton.

sections.BOUNDARY: No fruit is named; practice is described, not yet sealed.
sections.EXPLANATION: By wit subdued, being accomplished. Perfected, free-natured. As there, so elsewhere (continuity). Seed attending. Seat abiding, happily dived in lake. Own-measure making brings about. On wisdom perishing, birth perishing. Ka-class etc, great-lady etc, bound mothers. In three, the fourth oil-like to be poured (unbroken turya). Sunk, by own mind should enter. On breath coursing, even-seeing. In middle, inferior birthing. In mothers, on non-certainty joining, of destroyed, again rising. Śiva-equaled becomes. Body-course, vow. Talk, muttering. Giving, self-knowing.
sections.FUNCTION: Describes the practice arc: subdued, perfected, continuous, seeded, dived, made, perished, mothered, poured, entered, seen, birthed, risen, equaled, vowed, muttered, given.
sections.KEY TERMS: dhīvaśa (wit-subdued); turya (the fourth — oil-poured); bījāvadhāna (seed-attending); prāṇasamācāra (breath-coursing); mātṛkās (bound mothers); japa (all talk); dāna (all giving).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Practice described here is sealed by mantra-fruit and re-closing beyond.
sections.SUMMARY: By wit subdued, being accomplished. Perfected, free-natured. As there, so elsewhere. Seed attending. Seat abiding, happily dived in lake. Own-measure making brings about. On wisdom perishing, birth perishing. Ka-class etc, great-lady etc, bound mothers. In three, fourth oil-like to be poured. Sunk, by own mind should enter. On breath coursing, even-seeing. In middle, inferior birthing. In mothers, non-certainty joining, destroyed rises again. Śiva-equaled becomes. Body-course, vow. Talk, muttering. Giving, self-knowing.

essence: In proceeding even, non-rejecting, from knower-being.
From prattling, outward going of to-be-carried.
When ascended measured, from wasting, life wasting.

rasa.justification: Seventeen members settling one by one — heaped universe, unwatched proceeding, witnessed pleasure-pain, alone freed, tasted self — until the final re-closing shuts the book where opening opened it. The seal IS the rasa.

sections.BOUNDARY: Nothing follows; re-closing is the last word.
sections.EXPLANATION: Un-shepherded standing, knowing-cause (no master needed). Own-power heaping, universe (svaśakti-piled world). Standing-dissolving (one). In proceeding even, non-rejecting, from knower-being. Pleasure-pain outwardly minded (witnessed). From that freed but, alone. Delusion-massed but, deed-self (bound yet acting). On difference dismissal, other-world action-ness. Sense-power, from self, from tasting. Triple-step vivifying (whole sūtra). Mind-steady speech, in body-sense-outsides. From prattling, outward going of the to-be-carried. Ascended-and-measured: from its wasting, the wasting of life. Element-sheathed, then freed again — lord-equal, supreme. Natural, breath-link. Nose-inside-middle held: what is here, in the side and central channels? Again may be re-closing — the seal answering v1's opening.
sections.FUNCTION: Seals the tantra: unshepherded, heaped, paired, unrejected, witnessed, freed, acting, empowered, tasting, vivified, spoken, carried, wasted, freed, linked, channeled, closed.
sections.KEY TERMS: avi (un-shepherded — no master); anirāsa (non-rejecting); kevalī (alone); sargāntara (other worlds); tripadādi (triple-step); pratimīlana (re-closing — the seal); sauṣumna (middle channel).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The seal closes the whole: opening (unmeṣa) answered by re-closing (pratimīlana).
sections.RELATED: Colophon verse v75; Rudrayāmala ascription absent here (contrast Parātriṃśikā v36).
sections.SUMMARY: Un-shepherded standing, knowing-cause. Own-power heaping, universe. Standing-dissolving. In proceeding even, non-rejecting, from knower-being. Pleasure-pain, outward minding. From that freed, alone. Delusion-massed, deed-self. On difference dismissal, other-world action-ness. Sense-power, from self, from tasting. Triple-step vivifying. Mind-steady speech, in body-sense-outsides. From prattling, outward going of to-be-carried. When ascended measured, from wasting, life wasting. Element-sheathed, freed again, lord-equal supreme. Natural, breath-link. Nose-inside-middle restraint, what in channels? Again may be re-closing.

lines: Non-discernment is māyā, is deep sleep.
The three-triad enjoyer is the hero-lord.
From pure-reality joining — or the beast-power.
On power joining, the body arises.
In the womb: mind-unfolding, indistinct-wisdom dream.
On wisdom rising, natural: sky-going Śiva-state.
The guru — that is the means.
Of kalā and the rest, of realities: non-discernment is māyā.
In the body: the dissolving of parts.
From delusion's conquering, from endless enjoying: innate-wisdom conquering.
The inner self is the stage.
Abiding seated, happily dived in the lake.
Making one's own measure brings about.
In ka-class and the rest, the great-lady and the rest: the bound mothers.
In three, the fourth — to be poured like oil.
Sunk: by own mind let him enter.
On the coursing breath: even seeing.
Among mothers, joining without certainty — the destroyed rises again.
Who un-shepherded standing, is cause of knowing — and.
Heaping own power is the universe.
Even in its proceeding, non-rejecting, from the knower's being.
Massed with delusion, yet the acting self.
The sense-power, from self, from tasting.
Mind-steady in speech, amid outer body-senses.
From prattle, the to-be-carried goes outward.
When that ascended is measured, from that wasting, life is wasting.
Sheathed in elements, then freed again: lord-equal, supreme.
